meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的 bug 时,它会先调查根因,再自动生成一个带复现步骤、根因和修复建议的 GitHub issue(或对 openai/codex 的 PR),并打上 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你要求「报告」「提交」或「分类」LazyCodex、Codex 插件或 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 报个 bug:安装后提示找不到命令
把这个 Codex CLI 的崩溃整理成 GitHub issue
say.note: 它自动补齐环境、根因和复现步骤

say.text: 这个 bug 该归到哪个仓库?先查清楚再提交
say.note: 它会比对源码后路由到正确仓库

howto.what_en: When you report a LazyCodex or Codex CLI bug, it investigates the root cause, then auto-generates a GitHub issue (or PR for openai/codex) with reproduction steps, root cause, and fix suggestion, labeled lazycodex-generated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'report', 'file', or 'triage' a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or Codex CLI.

say_en.text: File a bug for LazyCodex: installer says command not found
say_en.note: It investigates and creates an issue.

say_en.text: Turn this Codex CLI crash into a GitHub issue
say_en.note: It fills in environment, root cause, and steps.

say_en.text: Which repo owns this bug? Verify before filing
say_en.note: It compares sources and routes correctly.
